title: Recruiting Reena

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Do you think if I reconfigure the backlighting of these struts to create a crimson beam angle it would have the right effect?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think if I reconfigure the backlighting of these struts to create a crimson beam angle it would have the right effect?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: The red warning lights here. They’re magnificent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The red warning lights here. They’re magnificent.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: I’m planning my new expression. It’s going to be called Vermillion Rain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m planning my new expression. It’s going to be called Vermillion Rain.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Light. I am talking about my art, my eternal practice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Light. I am talking about my art, my eternal practice.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: With the right lensed troffers and electromagnetic ballast lamps, one can achieve anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With the right lensed troffers and electromagnetic ballast lamps, one can achieve anything.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: I am the light at the end of the tunnel. I am lumen, kelvin, phosphorescence. I am Reena.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am the light at the end of the tunnel. I am lumen, kelvin, phosphorescence. I am Reena.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: CorpSec betray the neon they wear. They are agents of shadow. May they wallow in shade. They deemed my last three expressions unlawful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec betray the neon they wear. They are agents of shadow. May they wallow in shade. They deemed my last three expressions unlawful.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: My most recent piece was called "Quotas Stare Back". I hacked the terminals at CorpSec HQ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My most recent piece was called "Quotas Stare Back". I hacked the terminals at CorpSec HQ.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Then your eyes must be full of shadow too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then your eyes must be full of shadow too.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: O.R.S. No. Are they an art movement?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: O.R.S. No. Are they an art movement?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: An obscure art movement I have never heard of. You’ve piqued my interest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An obscure art movement I have never heard of. You’ve piqued my interest.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: I have already joined. The light of my answer is only just reaching your brain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have already joined. The light of my answer is only just reaching your brain.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: It will look as if the Oil Rig is taking off, leaving this earth for a new world among the stars…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It will look as if the Oil Rig is taking off, leaving this earth for a new world among the stars…

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Then I re-programmed them to display fractal mandalas that induced temporary blindness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I re-programmed them to display fractal mandalas that induced temporary blindness.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Then I have no time for them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I have no time for them.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: What about it? Have you met any artists here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about it? Have you met any artists here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I still don’t know what you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still don’t know what you mean?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I still don’t know what you mean?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I still don’t know what you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds amazing. How will you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds amazing. How will you do it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds amazing. How will you do it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds amazing. How will you do it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do CorpSec think about your "expressions"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do CorpSec think about your "expressions"?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do CorpSec think about your "expressions"?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do CorpSec think about your "expressions"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is it true there are hidden messages in your art?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it true there are hidden messages in your art?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is it true there are hidden messages in your art?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is it true there are hidden messages in your art?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mmm, I can see why they didn’t like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmm, I can see why they didn’t like that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mmm, I can see why they didn’t like that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mmm, I can see why they didn’t like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have to go. Good luck with the art.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to go. Good luck with the art.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have to go. Good luck with the art.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have to go. Good luck with the art.

limitations: Static asset graph, not a simulation of game code or save state.
Conditions are preserved, not evaluated; route totals are conditional on them.
Only literal assignments and increments are interpreted; other scripts stay unparsed.
Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
